title: Hygiene recall with two deep pockets and a new blood pressure medication

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Anything new with your health since your last cleaning?

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: My doctor started me on lisinopril for blood pressure in the spring.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Okay, I'll update that. Any allergies change?

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Starting the probing. Upper right. Number three, three two three, buccal. Lingual three three five.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Number three distolingual is five with bleeding.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Moving on, everything twos and threes until number fourteen. Fourteen mesiobuccal is a four.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: It's mild. We'll keep an eye on it. Doing a regular adult cleaning today, prophy and polish.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I did her periodic exam, looks good otherwise, no new decay. Let's see her back in six months for her next cleaning.

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: Sounds good. My daughter's wedding is in June so I want my teeth looking great.
